name: galeShapley_isStable
lines: n : ℕ
inst✝ : NeZero n
w m : Preferences n
⊢ Matching.IsStable (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) (Matching.ofGS (gs w m) ⋯)
i j : Fin n
⊢ ¬Matching.IsBlocking (MatchingMarket.ofEquivData w m) (Matching.ofGS (gs w m) ⋯) i j
⊢ idxOf j (w.prefs i) ≤ idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i) ∧ ¬idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i) ≤ idxOf j (w.prefs i) →
idxOf i (m.prefs j) ≤ idxOf ((Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) ⋯).symm j) (m.prefs j) →
¬¬idxOf ((Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) ⋯).symm j) (m.prefs j) ≤ idxOf i (m.prefs j)
hprefI : idxOf j (w.prefs i) ≤ idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i) ∧ ¬idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i) ≤ idxOf j (w.prefs i)
hprefJ : idxOf i (m.prefs j) ≤ idxOf ((Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) ⋯).symm j) (m.prefs j)
⊢ ¬¬idxOf ((Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) ⋯).symm j) (m.prefs j) ≤ idxOf i (m.prefs j)
left✝ : idxOf j (w.prefs i) ≤ idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i)
hI_strict : ¬idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i) ≤ idxOf j (w.prefs i)
hI_strict : idxOf j (w.prefs i) < idxOf (gs w m i) (w.prefs i)
wife : Fin n := (Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) ⋯).symm j
hprefJ : idxOf i (m.prefs j) ≤ idxOf wife (m.prefs j)
wife_def : wife = (Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) ⋯).symm j
⊢ ¬¬idxOf wife (m.prefs j) ≤ idxOf i (m.prefs j)
hwife_apply : gs w m wife = j
hwife_holds : (finalState w m).holding wife = some j
⊢ (finalState w m).holding wife = some j
h : Fin n
hh : (finalState w m).holding wife = some h
hgs : gs w m wife = h
⊢ gs w m wife = h
hwife_apply : h = j
hwife_in : wife ∈ take ((finalState w m).nextChoice j) (m.prefs j)
hj_prefs_mem : ∀ (x : Fin n), x ∈ m.prefs j
hwife_lt : idxOf wife (m.prefs j) < (finalState w m).nextChoice j
hi_lt : idxOf i (m.prefs j) < (finalState w m).nextChoice j

steps.tactic: simp only [Matching.IsBlocking, Matching.ofGS, MatchingMarket.ofEquivData, strict, not_and]
set wife : Fin n := (Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) (gs_bijective w m)).symm j with wife_def
have hwife_apply : gs w m wife = j := (Equiv.ofBijective (gs w m) (gs_bijective w m)).apply_symm_apply j

have hwife_holds : (finalState w m).holding wife = some j :=
  by
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := final_all_women_hold w m wife
  have hgs : gs w m wife = h := by simp [gs, hh]
  rw [hgs] at hwife_apply
  exact hwife_apply ▸ hh
obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := final_all_women_hold w m wife
have hgs : gs w m wife = h := by simp [gs, hh]
have hwife_in : wife ∈ (m.prefs j).take ((finalState w m).nextChoice j) := holdinv_finalState w m j wife hwife_holds
have hj_prefs_mem : ∀ x : Fin n, x ∈ m.prefs j := pref_list_mem _ (m.valid j).1 (m.valid j).2

have hwife_lt : (m.prefs j).idxOf wife < (finalState w m).nextChoice j :=
  (List.mem_take_iff_idxOf_lt (hj_prefs_mem wife)).mp hwife_in
have hi_lt : (m.prefs j).idxOf i < (finalState w m).nextChoice j := lt_of_le_of_lt hprefJ hwife_lt
exact absurd (rsinv_stability w m j i hi_lt) (not_le.mpr hI_strict)
